units: arbitrary D scene units; not metric recovered dimensions

method.geometry: evaluated dependency-graph meshes, transformed by evaluated matrix_world
method.bvh: zero-epsilon triangle BVH plus original polygon BVH for historic count comparison
method.strict_crossing: at least one edge penetrates both sides of opposing triangle plane by >1e-7 scene units, and positive AABB overlap >1e-7 on all axes; exact tangencies/float noise cannot certify volume interpenetration; no assertion from AABB alone
limits: Structural intersections are categorized as possible intended joins, not silently called defects.
No render or camera/source match assessed.
No solid-containment check for unrelated nested objects; curtain/blind tested with transverse surface intersections.

depth_separation_parameters.note: Negative world Y points toward room/camera. Values provide conservative global Y interval separation independent of camera; example clearance is not source-measured.
